final: WITH pa AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern` HAVING AVG(`aCL IgG`) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall FROM pa), ab AS (SELECT pa.pattern, pa.avg_igg, o.overall FROM pa, o WHERE pa.avg_igg > o.overall), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_above FROM ab) SELECT ab.pattern, ab.avg_igg, ab.avg_igg - ab.overall AS above_overall_avg, ab.avg_igg - m.mean_above AS diff_from_above_group_avg FROM ab, m ORDER BY ab.avg_igg DESC
